title: Official poverty thresholds, 2024
description: Complete 48-cell Census grid, arranged by family size, householder age and related children under 18.
geography: United States; thresholds do not vary geographically
methodology: Each nonblank amount is transcribed automatically from its retained official PDF reader line. Income is compared with the exact applicable cell, not a weighted-average threshold. Blank cells are not zero. Family definitions and the statistical universe are retained in the measurement comparison.
